networks.name: rayo
networks.description: Find open agentic websites for a job, ranked on evidence: spec checks, integrity, safety scans, behaviour probes and links from other sites.
sample_queries: Is there an agent site that can explain a bank letter in plain words?
Find me a site whose agent can actually place an order, not just talk about it.
Why does Agent Customs rank where it does? Is it safe to link to?
How fresh is your index and how do you rank sites?
Book me a table at a restaurant in Hyderabad tonight.

peer_policy.note: Calls no partner sites. Its searches are shared with every site through the bridge.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
